edits:
The current light-source selection still depends on the server's English `Lit` status prefix and a station presentation kind, rather than a typed world-authored light description. This is a concrete engine/world boundary gap under [EWF04](maintainers/extensible-world-foundation.md#ewf04--generic-permitted-inspection-context-and-presentation), not permission to make display wording a lighting contract. The correction must preserve scoped source disclosure, immediate revocation and the existing bounded selection; it does not require another renderer or a general astronomy simulator.

The client evaluator supplies a reusable presentation mechanism, not universal astronomy. The current bundled preset is still located in the client; [EWF04](maintainers/extensible-world-foundation.md#ewf04--generic-permitted-inspection-context-and-presentation) owns moving its authored sky/light choices behind the permitted world presentation seam. Other coherent worlds can have different skies without changing the engine evaluator or interpreting English status text. Keep the current daily arc as bundled content, preserve received-clock semantics, and avoid an unused calendar/season framework. No per-artwork metadata is needed.
files.summary: identify the current lighting boundary and its existing owner
